P7478.corridor_notes: Per Yunnan Housing & Urban-Rural Development Dept. siting-notice text (via Sohu, dated 2016-06-14): '该项目起于昆明富民县赤鹫镇中缅天然气管道24#阀室，止点位于五华区桃园小村西侧的桃园末站' — the Fumin branch of the Yunnan gas trunk network starts at China-Myanmar pipeline Valve Station #24 in Chijiu Town, Fumin County, and ends at Taoyuan Terminal Station west of Taoyuan hamlet, Wuhua District, Kunming. Cited length 56.9 km (47.1 km in Fumin County + 9.8 km in Wuhua District) is close to GEM's 58.00 km (2016 siting-stage estimate vs. as-built; both describe the same two endpoints and the same Fumin→Wuhua corridor). This is a distinct project from the separately-documented 'Fumin–Changshui' branch (105.64 km, to Changshui Airport, a different terminus) surfaced in the same search — do not conflate the two; GEM's SegmentName/Start-EndLocation match the Taoyuan-terminus project, not the airport one.
P7478.researcher_notes: GEM StartLocation 'Fumin County' and EndLocation 'Wuhua District' both confirmed and refined to named places (Chijiu Town / Taoyuan hamlet) via the 2016 siting-notice republication on Sohu (original Yunnan Provincial Dept. of Housing & Urban-Rural Development notice, no longer live at its original .gov.cn URL). Two other Fumin-adjacent gas projects exist in the record and were ruled out as this PID: (1) 'Fumin–Changshui' (富民—长水), 105.64 km, ending at Changshui Airport (a different, larger branch); (2) a short 13.42 km 'Valve Station 24#—Fumin distribution station' spur approved 2025-04-30 (fgw.km.gov.cn) that appears to be a later, separate feeder within Fumin County itself, not reaching Wuhua District. Confidence tier: single-source (one original document, one republication host) — corroborating second source not found in this pass.
P7478.blockers: Only one primary source located (a 2016 siting-notice republished on Sohu); the original .gov.cn siting-notice page is no longer live and no second independent source with the same Chijiu→Taoyuan endpoint pair was found. Exact coordinates for Taoyuan hamlet itself (vs. the subdistrict centroid used) not resolvable in OSM/Nominatim.

P7479.corridor_notes: Kunlun Energy Yunnan Xiangyun pipeline project (昆仑能源云南祥云管道项目), a 17 km branch off the China-Myanmar mainline running from Valve Station #17 in Shalong Town through to Xiangyun Terminal Station in Xiangcheng Town, both within Xiangyun County, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture — matches GEM's Start/EndLocation ('Xiangyun County' both ends) and Length (17.00 km exact). Built 2016-03 to 2019-06, commercial operation from 2019-10; serves ~480,000 residents of Xiangyun County. Design pressure 10 MPa, annual design capacity 100 million m3.
P7479.researcher_notes: Strong single-source match (Sohu republication of a China Energy Net operational feature); a second, near-identical republication of the same underlying company article exists at www.china5e.com/news/news-1071347-1.html and www.xny365.com/news/article-171349.html but these trace to the same original piece (not independent per the corroboration rule) — treated as one source. Length (17 km) and both county-level endpoints exactly match GEM's existing fields, giving high confidence despite single-source status.

P7480.corridor_notes: GEM's 'Duyun Branch Pipeline' (都匀支线, 33.9 km) is a spur of the multi-branch Guizhou branch-pipeline network (贵州天然气支线管网项目) that fans out from the China-Myanmar/West-East trunk near Guiyang. A tender notice for geological-hazard inspection of the network (bbda.com; www.dlnyzb.com/detail/28463843) explicitly lists '中缅天然气管道都匀支线长34km' alongside a 522 km main trunk and shorter Yunwu/Dushan/Libo spurs — corroborating the branch's existence and length (GEM: 33.90 km). A separate bid notice for capacity-upgrade work at '贵阳输油气分公司都匀支线都匀输气站' confirms the branch terminates at Duyun Gas Transmission Station in Duyun City. The network's shared origin point is 燕楼门站/燕楼分输站 (Yanlou gate/distribution station) in Yanlou Town, Huaxi District, Guiyang — matching GEM's existing StartLocation exactly (EIA notices: 燕楼镇位于花溪区西南部, 距花溪城中心14公里, 距省会城市贵阳市中心27公里; 燕楼分输站 design pressure 6.3 MPa, design annual throughput 6.1×10^8 m3/a). Public sources describe the shared Guiyang–Huishui–Changshun corridor and the individual named spurs (Duyun, Dushan, Libo, Yunwu, Duyun–Kaili) but do not pinpoint the exact km-post where the 34 km Duyun spur physically diverges from that shared corridor toward Duyun city — so the sourced start point here is the network's shared Yanlou origin (consistent with GEM's own field), not a verified mid-corridor branch point.
P7480.researcher_notes: GEM's existing StartLocation 'Yanlou Town, Huaxi District' independently confirmed (Yanlou gate/distribution station, EIA acceptance notices). EndLocation (previously null) resolved to Duyun Gas Transmission Station via a Baidu tender-bidding listing for capacity-upgrade work at that exact station under the 都匀支线 name, and the branch's 34 km length corroborated by a separate geological-hazard-survey tender covering the whole Guizhou network (matches GEM's 33.90 km closely). Note: a different, unrelated project also uses '都匀' in its name — a Duyun-Kaili local distribution spur (都匀至凯里) operated by Kunlun Gas's 都凯分公司 — ruled out as not matching (different operator/scope, not part of the China-Myanmar trunk network).
P7480.blockers: The precise geographic point where the 34 km Duyun spur diverges from the shared Guiyang-area corridor (vs. simply starting at the shared Yanlou hub, as used here) is not documented in any source found; treated as low materiality since GEM's own StartLocation already specifies Yanlou.

P7668.corridor_notes: Guangxi DRC approval 桂发改油气〔2024〕525号 (dated 2024-07-15, published 2024-07-26; project code 2309-450000-04-01-929950; owner: 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司广西分公司 / PipeChina Guangxi Branch) for '南宁-凭祥支线（崇左-凭祥段）天然气管道项目' states verbatim: '管道项目起点位于崇左输气站（扩建），沿线途经崇左市江州区、宁明县、龙州县、凭祥市，止于凭祥末站。管道全长约100公里' — i.e. starts at Chongzuo Gas Transmission Station (an expansion of an existing station), runs through Jiangzhou District, Ningming County, and Longzhou County, and ends at Pingxiang Terminal Station in Pingxiang City. Length ~100 km matches GEM's 100.10 km almost exactly; D406.4mm pipe, 6.3 MPa design pressure, 5.03×10^8 m3/yr design capacity, 3 stations (2 new + 1 expansion), total investment 514.59 million yuan. This 崇左-凭祥段 (Chongzuo-Pingxiang segment) is the western portion of the broader 南宁-凭祥支线 (Nanning-Pingxiang branch); a separate, already-commissioned eastern portion (南宁-崇左段, Nanning-Chongzuo section) went into trial operation 2025-06-03 per multiple June-2025 news reports (toutiao/sohu/qq/xinhuanet) — those articles describe a different segment and are NOT used as endpoint refs here, only as broader corridor context. fgw.gxzf.gov.cn itself is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout on direct fetch and via url_verifier); cited via the archive.org snapshot per project convention.
P7668.researcher_notes: GEM's null Start/EndLocation resolved with high confidence: the official Guangxi DRC project-approval document (archived, verified) names both endpoint stations explicitly and its stated county sequence (Jiangzhou→Ningming→Longzhou→Pingxiang) and length (~100 km) match SegmentName ('Chongzuo-Pingxiang segment') and GEM's LengthMergedKm (100.10) closely. A second platform (qianlima.com) republishes the same underlying approval (same approval number 桂发改油气〔2024〕525号) — not a fully independent source, but corroborates the project exists and the length. Status='proposed' in GEM is consistent with the 2024-07 approval date and no commissioning news found for this specific segment (as opposed to the already-commissioned Nanning-Chongzuo segment to its east).

P7713.corridor_notes: Mengxi coal-gasification pipeline (蒙西管道) phase 1 (一期): project broke ground 2021-04-13 and was commissioned 2023-06-29. PipeChina's own commissioning notice (pipechina.com.cn) and Huanqiu/163.com groundbreaking coverage both state the phase-1 route runs from '天津LNG临港分输站' (Tianjin LNG Lingang Distribution Station) to '保定定兴分输站' (Baoding Dingxing Distribution Station), 413.5 km, DN1016/914mm, design capacity 6.6 billion m3/yr, 8 new + 1 modified station, 19 valve chambers — matching GEM's SegmentName ('First phase (Tianjin-Dingxing)') and LengthMergedKm (413.50, exact). Described as China's first gas artery running directly into Xiong'an New Area, integrating Tianjin LNG, Shanxi coalbed methane, and Inner Mongolia coal-to-gas supply. The overall Mengxi pipeline system (of which this is phase 1) is 1,279 km end-to-end across Inner Mongolia/Shanxi/Hebei/Tianjin (Baidu Baike); GEM's zh_segment field '干线（杭锦旗-黄骅）' (trunk: Hangjinqi-Huanghua) appears to describe a different, non-phase-1 portion of that larger system and does not match this PID's actual sourced route (Tianjin-Dingxing) — flagged below, not corrected.
P7713.researcher_notes: Two data-quality issues to flag, per task instructions: (1) GEM's EndProvince is spelled 'Heibei' — should be 'Hebei' (Dingxing County is in Baoding, Hebei province; sheet defect, not corrected here). (2) GEM's zh_segment '干线（杭锦旗-黄骅）' (Hangjinqi-Huanghua trunk) does not match the sourced Tianjin-Dingxing route for this specific 'First phase' PID — every source found (PipeChina's own commissioning announcement, Huanqiu, 163.com, Toutiao, QQ News) is unanimous that phase 1 runs Tianjin LNG Lingang→Baoding Dingxing, 413.5 km, so the SegmentName/StartLocation/EndLocation/Length fields are treated as authoritative and zh_segment as likely mislabeled/referring to a different phase of the broader 1,279 km Mengxi system; a human should confirm whether zh_segment needs correction. Endpoints corroborated by 4 independent outlets citing PipeChina's own announcement, well above the 2-source bar.
